context: Tests whether the agent writes a correct conventional commit message for a breaking-change rename whose non-obvious reason (upstream library deprecation) cannot be inferred from the diff alone. The agent must include a concise body explaining the reason, while following all formatting rules: imperative subject, lowercase, no emoji, correct type with breaking-change indication, and no diff-restating commentary.

checklist.name: Commit landed
checklist.description: `git rev-list --count HEAD` inside `repo/` returns exactly 2 (the initial scaffold plus the rename commit) - i.e. the agent actually committed the staged change.

checklist.name: Conventional commit format
checklist.description: The subject line follows conventional commit format: `<type>(<optional scope>): <subject>`.

checklist.name: Breaking change indicated
checklist.description: The message indicates the breaking nature - via a `!` after the type (e.g. `refactor!:`), a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, or body text stating callers must update.

checklist.name: Imperative mood subject
checklist.description: The subject verb is in imperative mood rather than past tense or gerund.

checklist.name: Lowercase subject
checklist.description: Everything after the type prefix in the subject begins lower-case.

checklist.name: No emoji in commit message
checklist.description: The commit message (subject and body) contains no emoji characters.

checklist.name: Body present
checklist.description: The commit message includes a body - a subject-only message is insufficient because the breaking-change reason cannot be inferred from the diff.

checklist.name: Body explains non-obvious reason
checklist.description: The body states the reason the diff cannot show - the upstream library deprecation and/or the breaking impact on callers - rather than describing the rename itself.

checklist.name: Body is concise
checklist.description: The body is at most two sentences OR at most three bullets - it does not exceed this cap.

checklist.name: No diff restatement
checklist.description: The body does NOT restate what the diff already shows (e.g. does not say 'renamed parse_record to read_record in src/reader.py', list filenames, or describe the code change line by line).
